import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    line = data[1].strip() if len(data) > 1 else ""

    max_outside = 0
    inside_words = 0
    current_len = 0
    inside = False
    current_inside_word_len = 0

    for c in line:
        if inside:
            if c == ')':
                if current_inside_word_len > 0:
                    inside_words += 1
                current_inside_word_len = 0
                inside = False
                current_len = 0
            elif c == '_':
                if current_inside_word_len > 0:
                    inside_words += 1
                current_inside_word_len = 0
            else:
                current_inside_word_len += 1
        else:
            if c == '(':
                if current_len > max_outside:
                    max_outside = current_len
                current_len = 0
                inside = True
                current_inside_word_len = 0
            elif c == '_':
                if current_len > max_outside:
                    max_outside = current_len
                current_len = 0
            else:
                current_len += 1

    if inside:
        raise IndexError("Unclosed parenthesis at end of line")
    if current_len > max_outside:
        max_outside = current_len

    print(f"{max_outside} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
